metadata.description: Plugins from Dotfusion: content operations, AEO and composable platform migration tools.

plugins.name: dotfusion-content-equity
plugins.description: Accelerate a large scale content migration. Scores every page on your site and gives your content team a verb for each (keep, consolidate, rewrite, redirect, retire or create), the rule behind it, a redirect map and a work queue. Works with or without GA4 and Search Console exports.
